idea-plugin.name: Datacircle MCP Server
idea-plugin.description:
Use Datacircle's MCP server from your IDE's AI agents: AI Assistant, Junie, GitHub Copilot, Codex and Claude.

It gets a LinkedIn profile from its URL, through Up2Data, HarvestAPI or Fetchin.

Getting started

  1. Log in at datacircle.dev/login with your work email. Your API key is on the page once you're in.
  2. Install the plugin, click Connect and paste your key.
  3. Turn the server on when your IDE asks.

The plugin adds https://api.datacircle.dev/mcp to the MCP server list your AI agents share, with your key as a Bearer token. To change the key: Tools | Set Datacircle API Key.

Sign up at datacircle.dev with your work email: a $5 credit, that's 2,105 LinkedIn profiles at $2.375 per 1,000. See Pricing and the MCP server's docs.
